```{r}
FASTA_URL  <- "https://research.nhgri.nih.gov/HydraAEP/download/sequences/hv_aep/HVAEP.genome.fa.gz"
FASTA_GZ   <- "HVAEP.genome.fa.gz"
FASTA_FILE <- "HVAEP.genome.fa"

if (!file.exists(FASTA_GZ) && !file.exists(FASTA_FILE)) {
  cat("Downloading FASTA...\n")
  download.file(FASTA_URL, FASTA_GZ, mode = "wb")
}

if (!file.exists(FASTA_FILE)) {
  cat("Decompressing FASTA...\n")
  R.utils::gunzip(FASTA_GZ, destname = FASTA_FILE, remove = FALSE)
  cat("Done.\n\n")
} else {
  cat("FASTA already decompressed – skipping gunzip.\n\n")
}
```

```{r}

GFF3_URL <- "https://research.nhgri.nih.gov/HydraAEP/download/coordinates/hv_aep/HVAEP.GeneModels.gff3.gz"
GFF3_FILE <- "HVAEP.GeneModels.gff3.gz"

if (!file.exists(GFF3_FILE)) {
  cat("Downloading AEP GFF3 from NHGRI portal...\n")
  tryCatch(
    download.file(GFF3_URL, GFF3_FILE, mode = "wb"),
    error = function(e) stop(
      "\nDownload failed. Please download manually:\n",
      "  URL: ", GFF3_URL, "\n",
      "  Save as: ", GFF3_FILE, "\n",
      "  in your R working directory (", getwd(), ")\n"
    )
  )
  cat("Download complete.\n\n")
} else {
  cat("GFF3 file found locally – skipping download.\n\n")
}

```
```{r}
## ── 2. Parse GFF3 ─────────────────────────────────────────────
cat("Importing GFF3...\n")
gff_all <- import(GFF3_FILE)

```
```{r}
## The NHGRI AEP GFF3 uses type "gene" for gene-level features.
## Check what types are present if the gene count looks wrong.
cat("Feature types in GFF3:\n")
print(table(gff_all$type))

genes <- gff_all[gff_all$type == "gene"]
cat("\nGene records:", length(genes), "\n")

## Sanity check – expect ~28,917
if (length(genes) == 0) {
  # Some custom GFF3s use "mRNA" as the top-level feature instead of "gene"
  cat("No 'gene' features found – trying 'mRNA' as top-level feature...\n")
  genes <- gff_all[gff_all$type == "mRNA"]
  # Deduplicate by locus (keep widest range per ID)
  cat("mRNA records:", length(genes), "\n")
}
```

```{r}
## ── 3. Scaffold lengths ───────────────────────────────────────
## Strategy 1: parse ##sequence-region pragma lines from GFF3 header
## Strategy 2: derive from the max end coordinate per scaffold in the GFF3
## (The NHGRI custom GFF3 may not include ##sequence-region lines, so we
##  use strategy 2 as a robust fallback.)

cat("\nExtracting scaffold lengths from GFF3 header lines...\n")
con <- gzcon(file(GFF3_FILE, "rb"))
hdr_lines <- character(0)
repeat {
  ln <- readLines(con, n = 1, warn = FALSE)
  if (length(ln) == 0 || !startsWith(ln, "#")) break
  hdr_lines <- c(hdr_lines, ln)
}
close(con)

seq_rgn <- grep("^##sequence-region", hdr_lines, value = TRUE)

if (length(seq_rgn) > 0) {
  parts       <- strsplit(trimws(seq_rgn), "\\s+")
  chr_lengths <- setNames(
    as.integer(sapply(parts, `[`, 4)),
    sapply(parts, `[`, 2)
  )
  cat("Found", length(chr_lengths),
      "scaffold lengths from ##sequence-region headers.\n")
} else {
  cat("No ##sequence-region headers found.\n",
      "Deriving scaffold lengths from max(end) per scaffold in GFF3...\n")
  # Use ALL features (not just genes) for most accurate scaffold extent
  all_df <- as.data.frame(gff_all)
  scaf_max <- all_df %>%
    group_by(seqnames) %>%
    summarise(max_end = max(end), .groups = "drop")
  chr_lengths <- setNames(scaf_max$max_end,
                          as.character(scaf_max$seqnames))
  cat("Derived lengths for", length(chr_lengths), "scaffolds.\n")
}
```
```{r}
## ── 4. Helper: safe GFF attribute extractor ───────────────────
get_attr <- function(gr, field) {
  if (field %in% names(mcols(gr)))
    as.character(mcols(gr)[[field]])
  else
    rep(NA_character_, length(gr))
}
```

```{r}
## ── 5. Gene name ──────────────────────────────────────────────
## AEP gene IDs follow the pattern: HVAEP<scaffold>.G<num>
## The GFF3 stores this in the 'ID' attribute; 'Name' may also be present.
gene_name_vec <- get_attr(genes, "Name")
gene_name_vec <- ifelse(is.na(gene_name_vec),
                        get_attr(genes, "ID"), gene_name_vec)

scaff_names <- as.character(seqnames(genes))

```

```{r}
## ── 6. Base table ─────────────────────────────────────────────
gene_df <- tibble(
  gene_name           = gene_name_vec,
  scaffold_chr        = scaff_names,
  start               = start(genes),
  end                 = end(genes),
  strand              = as.character(strand(genes)),
  gene_length         = width(genes),
  scaffold_chr_length = chr_lengths[scaff_names]
)

cat("\nPreview of gene names (first 6):\n")
print(head(gene_df$gene_name))
```
##scaffold level gene density
```{r}
scaffold_density <- gene_df %>%
  group_by(scaffold_chr) %>%
  summarise(
    n_genes        = n(),
    scaffold_length = first(scaffold_chr_length),
    gene_density_per_mb = n_genes / (scaffold_length / 1e6),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

gene_df <- gene_df %>%
  left_join(scaffold_density %>% select(scaffold_chr, gene_density_per_mb, n_genes),
            by = "scaffold_chr")
```

##Distance to nearest gene
```{r}
gene_gr <- makeGRangesFromDataFrame(
  gene_df,
  seqnames.field  = "scaffold_chr",
  start.field     = "start",
  end.field       = "end",
  strand.field    = "strand",
  keep.extra.columns = TRUE
)
# For each gene, distance to its nearest *other* gene
dist_hits  <- distanceToNearest(gene_gr, ignore.strand = TRUE)
gene_df$dist_to_nearest_gene_bp <- NA_real_
gene_df$dist_to_nearest_gene_bp[queryHits(dist_hits)] <- mcols(dist_hits)$distance
```


##Read in Opsin IDs
```{r}
opsin_ids_raw <- readLines("AEP.txt")
head(opsin_ids_raw)  # check format before stripping
opsin_ids_stripped <- opsin_ids_raw
```
```{r}
gene_df <- gene_df %>%
  mutate(is_opsin = gene_name %in% opsin_ids_stripped)

cat("Opsin genes flagged:", sum(gene_df$is_opsin), "\n")
```
```{r}
dup_pairs <- read_tsv("dup_pairsAEP.tsv", col_types = cols()) %>%
  rename(dup1 = 1, dup2 = 2, dup_type = 3) %>%
  filter(!is.na(dup_type), dup_type != "type")

cat("Pairs loaded:", nrow(dup_pairs), "\n")
print(count(dup_pairs, dup_type))
```


```{r}
pair_features_full <- dup_pairs %>%
  mutate(
    dup1_key = str_replace(dup1, "^AEP_", ""),
    dup2_key = str_replace(dup2, "^AEP_", "")
  ) %>%
  left_join(gene_df %>% select(gene_name, gene_length, dist_to_nearest_gene_bp,
                                gene_density_per_mb, scaffold_chr_length, is_opsin),
            by = c("dup1_key" = "gene_name")) %>%
  rename_with(~paste0(.x, "_dup1"), c(gene_length, dist_to_nearest_gene_bp,
                                       gene_density_per_mb, scaffold_chr_length, is_opsin)) %>%
  left_join(gene_df %>% select(gene_name, gene_length, dist_to_nearest_gene_bp,
                                gene_density_per_mb, scaffold_chr_length, is_opsin),
            by = c("dup2_key" = "gene_name")) %>%
  rename_with(~paste0(.x, "_dup2"), c(gene_length, dist_to_nearest_gene_bp,
                                       gene_density_per_mb, scaffold_chr_length, is_opsin)) %>%
  mutate(
    mean_gene_density = (gene_density_per_mb_dup1 + gene_density_per_mb_dup2) / 2,
    mean_gene_length  = (gene_length_dup1 + gene_length_dup2) / 2,
    mean_dist_to_gene = (dist_to_nearest_gene_bp_dup1 + dist_to_nearest_gene_bp_dup2) / 2,
    either_opsin      = is_opsin_dup1 | is_opsin_dup2,
    dup_type          = factor(dup_type, levels = c("TD","PD","SD","DD"))
  )

# Quick sanity check
glimpse(pair_features_full)
cat("Rows with any NA in key features:", sum(!complete.cases(
  pair_features_full %>% select(mean_gene_density, mean_gene_length, mean_dist_to_gene)
)), "\n")
cat("Pairs involving at least one opsin:", sum(pair_features_full$either_opsin, na.rm=TRUE), "\n")

```

```{r}
model_data <- pair_features_full %>%
  filter(dup_type %in% c("TD", "DD")) %>%
  mutate(y = as.integer(dup_type == "TD")) %>%
  select(y, mean_dist_to_gene, mean_gene_density, mean_gene_length,
         scaffold_chr_length_dup1, either_opsin) %>%
  drop_na()

# Scale numeric predictors
num_cols <- c("mean_dist_to_gene", "mean_gene_density", "mean_gene_length", "scaffold_chr_length_dup1")
model_data[num_cols] <- scale(model_data[num_cols])

cat("Model dataset: n =", nrow(model_data),
    " | TD =", sum(model_data$y),
    " | DD =", sum(model_data$y == 0), "\n")
cat("Opsin pairs in model:", sum(model_data$either_opsin), "\n")

full_model <- glm(y ~ mean_dist_to_gene + mean_gene_density + mean_gene_length +
                      scaffold_chr_length_dup1 + either_opsin,
                  data   = model_data,
                  family = binomial(link = "logit"))

summary(full_model)
tidy(full_model, exponentiate = TRUE, conf.int = TRUE)
```


```{r}
# Window size in bp — 500kb is a reasonable start for Hydra
WINDOW <- 500000

# For each gene, count how many other genes fall within ± WINDOW bp
gene_gr_windows <- resize(gene_gr,
                           width = 2 * WINDOW + width(gene_gr),
                           fix   = "center")

# Count overlaps: how many genes does each window contain?
# subtract 1 to exclude the gene itself
hits <- countOverlaps(gene_gr_windows, gene_gr, ignore.strand = TRUE) - 1

# Add to gene_df
gene_df <- gene_df %>%
  mutate(
    local_gene_density = hits / (2 * WINDOW / 1e6)  # genes per Mb in window
  )

# Quick sanity check
summary(gene_df$local_gene_density)
```
```{r}
# Step 1: check what density columns actually exist now
colnames(pair_features_full)
```
```{r}
# Step 2: re-join local density
pair_features_full <- pair_features_full %>%
  select(-any_of(c("mean_gene_density", "gene_density_per_mb_dup1", 
                    "gene_density_per_mb_dup2", "local_density_dup1",
                    "local_density_dup2", "mean_local_density"))) %>%
  left_join(gene_df %>% select(gene_name, local_gene_density),
            by = c("dup1_key" = "gene_name")) %>%
  rename(local_density_dup1 = local_gene_density) %>%
  left_join(gene_df %>% select(gene_name, local_gene_density),
            by = c("dup2_key" = "gene_name")) %>%
  rename(local_density_dup2 = local_gene_density) %>%
  mutate(mean_local_density = (local_density_dup1 + local_density_dup2) / 2)

# Step 3: rebuild model_data with the new column
model_data <- pair_features_full %>%
  filter(dup_type %in% c("TD", "DD")) %>%
  mutate(y = as.integer(dup_type == "TD")) %>%
  select(y, mean_dist_to_gene, mean_local_density, mean_gene_length,
         scaffold_chr_length_dup1, either_opsin) %>%
  drop_na()

num_cols <- c("mean_dist_to_gene", "mean_local_density", 
              "mean_gene_length", "scaffold_chr_length_dup1")
model_data[num_cols] <- scale(model_data[num_cols])

# Step 4: now run the model
full_model <- glm(y ~ mean_dist_to_gene + mean_local_density + mean_gene_length +
                      scaffold_chr_length_dup1 + either_opsin,
                  data   = model_data,
                  family = binomial(link = "logit"))

summary(full_model)
tidy(full_model, exponentiate = TRUE, conf.int = TRUE)
```




```{r}
# Re-join with updated gene_df
pair_features_full <- pair_features_full %>%
  select(-mean_gene_density, -gene_density_per_mb_dup1, -gene_density_per_mb_dup2) %>%
  left_join(gene_df %>% select(gene_name, local_gene_density),
            by = c("dup1_key" = "gene_name")) %>%
  rename(local_density_dup1 = local_gene_density) %>%
  left_join(gene_df %>% select(gene_name, local_gene_density),
            by = c("dup2_key" = "gene_name")) %>%
  rename(local_density_dup2 = local_gene_density) %>%
  mutate(mean_local_density = (local_density_dup1 + local_density_dup2) / 2)
```

```{r}
full_model <- glm(y ~ mean_dist_to_gene + mean_local_density + mean_gene_length +
                      scaffold_chr_length_dup1 + either_opsin,
                  data   = model_data,
                  family = binomial(link = "logit"))
```
